hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

notAttached added (absent -> {reason}): the entry now states that this CommandLineTool implements no Implementation Profile, with the reason already given in docs/ATTACHMENTS.md (profiles.yaml tier3.reason). Nothing else changes: the process was not attached before and is not attached now (decision Q1 of 2026-11-11).
plan: executionUnit.href moves from GeoLabs/ogc-eo-application-package-hands-on f472585 to 72a76ae, pushed on 2026-11-11 (water-bodies/app-pkg-multiple/stac.cwl). The processDescription is unchanged.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/water-bodies/stac to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/water-bodies/stac, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/water-bodies/stac/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

prefLabel: Assemble a STAC catalog of detected water bodies
definition: Writes a STAC Catalog with one Item per input identifier, each carrying the corresponding water-body raster as an asset.

notAttached.reason: Export: writes a STAC Catalog of the results. No Generic Profile exports a catalogue.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Writes the final rasters to a self-describing output collection; save_result's STAC-catalog output option is the closest openEO equivalent to hand-assembling one.
